stories.story_specific_correction: Descending evidence layers. An uncertain insight links down to the rationale that supports checking it. No guaranteed recovery or performance score; the raw task record can challenge the stored insight.

Structural strength through weighted strata. A change admitted by architecture can then be checked against type and lint constraints. An ascending review path is a conceptual editorial metaphor; no universal defect capture or claim of exact checks in every team.
Large central specimen with smaller choices. The selected sample from the comparison is the basis for adapting one prompt. No copy guarantee, embedded brand or claimed automatic export success.

Confirmed document on the left, unfinished route on the right. The purchase record leads only to the next evidence question. The arrow lands on the rim of an empty pocket for delivery proof. No arrow to a delivered chip, exact origin, actual end use or confirmed licensing violation.

Two comparable tracks with a human approval gate. An in-bounds pilot sends its proposed action to the human approval gate. No claimed performance improvement, numeric baseline values, substitute for process ownership or unsupervised continuation.

A broken circular loop around a central experiment wheel. A hypothesis enters experiment capacity only when there is compute to run the test. No intact success loop, timetable, growth forecast or evidence that recursive self-improvement is inevitable.
